services.name: Turtle Canyons Snorkel Excursion
services.desc: Enjoy a trip along the Waikiki Coast to Turtle Canyons snorkeling site. Duration 2 Hours (approx.) About This spot is known for the large numbers of sea turtles that float above the reef while the reef fish swim around them and clean their shells. When the turtles come up to breath they can even be seen by spectators relaxing on the boat! After you have gotten your fill of snorkeling climb back onboard and relax in the sun with complimentary snack and beverages. Kick back and watch out for spinner dolphins and humpback whales (whales sighted in winter months December to April) while you cruise back to the harbor. services.name: Waikiki Sunset Cruise BYOB
services.desc: From January through March our sunset cruise is the best way to go whale watching! Hawaii is well known for its majestic sunsets, and there is truly no better way to experience it than on a boat out at sea. Duration 1.5 Hours About Come cruise the beautiful Waikiki coastline on our brand new boat! With an upper and lower deck and plenty of room on the bow, we offer many different vantage points for sunset viewing. Our cruise is for guests age 3 and up and is BYOB for guests 21 and over (no glass please). Bring your family or a date and spend a gorgeous evening out on the tropical waters of Oahu! services.name: Friday Night Waikiki Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Set sail for an unforgettable evening on our Waikiki Fireworks Cruise! Every Friday night, join us for a 1.5-hour scenic cruise that takes you out into the sparkling waters off Waikiki, where you'll experience a stunning fireworks display launched from the Hilton Hawaiian Village. Witness the magic of the fireworks illuminating the sky while enjoying breathtaking views of the Honolulu coastline from the comfort of our boat. As you soak in the sights, you can relax and enjoy refreshing alcoholic beverages available for purchase on board. services.name: Deluxe Snorkel and Wildlife Cruise
services.desc: Experience the ultimate island adventure with our Boat Tour in Waikiki, Hawaii! Get ready to cast off on an unforgettable journey that combines the beauty of the Pacific Ocean, thrilling water activities, and the chance to encounter incredible marine life. As the tour begins, we depart from the bustling Kewalo Basin harbor and embark on a short boat ride to our anchorage near Waikiki. Here, the magic truly begins.
